title: Recursive Binary Search
description:
Implement binary search recursively. Given a **sorted** list and a target value, return the index of the target, or `-1` if not found.

**Example:**
```
binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11], 7) → 3
binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 4) → -1
binary_search([], 1) → -1
```
hint: Base case: lo > hi → return -1. Find mid = (lo + hi) // 2. If lst[mid] == target return mid. If less, recurse right; if more, recurse left.
